name: Pit Fighters

specialRules.name: Pit Fighter
specialRules.text: All Pit Fighters have the Pit Fighter skill (Strength skill list): +1 WS and +1 A when fighting in ruins, buildings and the Pit.

specialRules.name: Free the Slaves!
specialRules.text: Pit Fighters hate all slavers and never sell captured opponents to slavers.

specialRules.name: In the Pit!
specialRules.text: A captured opponent may be made to fight a warband fighter in the Cutthroat's Haven pits. If the warband fighter wins he gains +2 Experience and the warband gets all the captive's armour and weapons plus 50gc. If he loses, roll for dead or injured as normal (ignoring Robbed, Captured, Hardened, Sold to the Pits and Survives against the Odds); he does not lose equipment, the captive still gets the 50gc and +2 Experience. If the captive wins, roll a D12; on 7+ he goes free, on 1-6 he remains captive and may be fielded in the pits later.

specialRules.name: Hired Swords
specialRules.text: May hire all Hired Swords except the Elf Ranger.

specialRules.name: Fighting styles
specialRules.text: Pit Fighters, Veterans, Pit King and Pursuers must buy a fighting style (a fixed weapon and armour bundle) instead of individual items. A style may be changed at any time by swapping with another warrior or buying a new one. Henchman groups may mix styles. Troll Slayer and Ogre buy individual items from their own list.

conversionNotes: Fighting styles are fixed bundles with a single price, so they are listed as items with category misc and the contents in note; the app may need to expand them into component items.

Pit Fighter special skill table (Bulging Biceps, Force of Will, Arms Master, Body Slam, Grizzled Veteran) and Troll Slayer skills (Ferocious Charge, Monster Slayer 4+ -> 7+, Berserker) are in the PDF; Body Slam critical on 5+ -> 9+; Force of Will D6 roll under Toughness left as printed.
Troll Slayer Hard to Kill: d6 injury 6 = out of action -> 12; 1-2 / 3-5 bands converted to 1-4 / 5-11 as a judgement call.
In the Pit! release roll D6 4+ -> D12 7+.
Pit Veteran profile row is labelled 'Pit King' in the PDF but is the Veteran profile (Ld 7, A 1, T 3).
Ogre Pit Fighter has no skill tables until it becomes a Hero; skills [] left empty. Slayer skills list includes the Troll Slayer Special Skills.
Dwarf Axe and Gromril Weapon (3 x cost) are Slayer only; Helmet and Light Armour are Ogre only; Slayers may never wear armour. Gromril listCost 0 with rule in note.
